definition.title: Stellar Laboratory
learning_objectives: Relate initial mass to typical main-sequence luminosity, radius, effective temperature, and broad colour.
Explain why more massive main-sequence stars are generally more luminous and shorter-lived.
Distinguish an approximate educational mass mapping from an age-resolved stellar-evolution track.
Connect broad initial-mass bands to textbook evolutionary paths and expected compact remnants while preserving boundary uncertainty.
prerequisite_concepts: solar mass, luminosity, and radius units

fields.name: initial_mass_msun
fields.meaning: Initial stellar mass used for the approximate main-sequence educational mapping.

input_schema.invalid_handling: Reject booleans, non-finite values, and values outside the reviewed v1 mass domain. No mass is silently clamped.

output_schema: typical main-sequence luminosity in nominal Solar luminosity units
typical main-sequence radius in nominal Solar radius units
approximate main-sequence lifetime rounded to two significant figures
expected remnant category with model-boundary caveat

equations.mass_luminosity: Six piece Eker et al. (2018) relation: log10(L/Lsun) = alpha*log10(M/Msun) + beta within the source-published mass domains.
equations.stefan_boltzmann_bridge: Missing branch uses Teff/Teff_sun = ((L/Lsun)/(R/Rsun)^2)^(1/4), equivalently R/Rsun = sqrt(L/Lsun)/(Teff/Teff_sun)^2, with nominal Teff_sun = 5772 K.
equations.lifetime_interpolation: Product-defined interpolation: linear interpolation in log10(mass) versus log10(lifetime) between adjacent OpenStax Table 22.1 anchors, rounded to two significant figures.
equations.colour_mapping: Choose the nearest selected Eker Table 7 source mass anchor and report that anchor's spectral type and B-V value; no continuous colour law is inferred.

definition.sampling_policy: This model returns one approximate parameter mapping for the requested initial mass. It does not integrate stellar structure with time or synthesize an evolutionary track.
definition.default_preset: Illustrative 1.0 nominal-Solar-mass main-sequence mapping. It is not a reconstruction of the present-day Sun and does not model Solar age or composition.
assumptions: Eker et al. relations describe typical approximately Solar-neighbourhood main-sequence stars and include real astrophysical scatter from age and composition.
IAU nominal Solar quantities are conversion constants, not claims about instantaneous true Solar properties.
The lifetime value is an interpolation between educational textbook anchors rather than a stellar-evolution grid prediction.
The B-V/spectral result is the nearest selected source anchor, not a fitted continuous colour model.
The remnant mapping is a broad textbook initial-mass classification and its boundaries are explicitly model-dependent.
limitations: No metallicity slider, helium abundance, rotation, magnetic activity, binarity, mass loss prescription, overshoot, diffusion, or detailed composition dependence.
No pre-main-sequence evolution, age-resolved main-sequence evolution, giant-branch track coordinates, isochrones, or post-main-sequence timescales.
The empirical mass-luminosity relation is piecewise and has source-reported scatter; outputs are typical estimates, not measurements of an individual star.
The lifetime interpolation is intentionally approximate and is rounded to two significant figures to avoid fake precision.
The colour result is a nearest source anchor and may change discretely as input mass crosses an anchor midpoint.
Black-hole outcomes are outside v1 because the reviewed empirical main-sequence/colour domain stops below the textbook >40 Msun black-hole band.

validation_fixtures.purpose: A 1 Msun input yields finite typical main-sequence values near the Solar scale without claiming a present-day Solar reconstruction.
Each Eker mass-luminosity branch is selected on the exact declared half-open/inclusive source boundary.
At M <= 1.5 Msun, luminosity and empirical radius reproduce the returned effective temperature through the IAU-normalized Stefan-Boltzmann ratio.
At M > 1.5 Msun, luminosity and empirical temperature reproduce the returned radius through the same ratio.
Exact selected Eker Table 7 anchor masses return the source spectral type and B-V value exactly.
Exact OpenStax Table 22.1 masses inside v1 return the source lifetime anchors exactly.
The product-defined log-log interpolation decreases across increasing mass anchors in the v1 domain.
Half-open v1 serialization boundaries at 8 and 10 Msun map deterministically to the cited broad end-state categories.
Identical canonical inputs return exactly identical immutable results.
Bool, non-finite, below-domain, and above-domain masses fail closed.
Source, constant, calibration, preset, and model-version drift is rejected by the strict artifact loader.

scientific_validation.method: Cross-check exact source table anchors and piecewise branch boundaries; verify Stefan-Boltzmann interrelation using the IAU nominal Solar effective-temperature conversion; verify deterministic lifetime interpolation and broad textbook remnant bands.

tools.name: pytest
tools.role: Source-anchor, limiting-case, branch, deterministic, domain, and artifact-integrity regression tests.
